title: Payments and allocations: record external payments and apply partial payments to invoices
description:
As an operator, I record a payment that arrived by bank transfer or check and apply it to one or more invoices, so that balances are right even when a client pays an invoice in several pieces or several invoices at once.

Feature: Payments and allocations
  Scenario: Record an external payment
    Given an issued invoice with balance 120000 (minor units)
    When an operator records a bank transfer of 50000 with reference and received date
    Then billing/payments/<uuid>.json exists with unallocated 50000, recorded by the operator's grant id, and the journal records it
  Scenario: Partial payment
    When the operator allocates 50000 of that payment to the invoice
    Then an allocation record exists, the invoice balance is 70000 and its status partially_paid, the payment's unallocated amount is zero
  Scenario: Several payments pay one invoice
    Given two further payments of 30000 and 40000 allocated to the same invoice
    Then the balance is zero, status paid, paid date set, and the three allocations are listed on the invoice
  Scenario: One payment pays several invoices
    Given a check for 90000 and three invoices of 30000
    When it is allocated 30000 to each
    Then all three are paid and the payment has no remainder
  Scenario: Over-allocation refused
    When an allocation exceeds the invoice balance or the payment's unallocated amount
    Then it is refused and nothing is written
  Scenario: Currency mismatch refused
    Given a payment in a currency different from the invoice
    Then allocation is refused
  Scenario: Reversal
    Given a bounced check
    When the operator reverses the payment
    Then a reversing payment and reversing allocations are written (reversal_of), the invoice returns to its previous balance and status, and the originals are untouched
  Scenario: Stripe payments arrive only by webhook
    Given a payment with method stripe_card
    When an operator tries to record it by hand
    Then it is refused; Stripe-collected money enters the ledger through the mirror only

Done looks like: `billing/payments.ts`, `billing/allocations.ts`, a `billing/balances.ts` that derives invoice balance and status from allocations (never stored without being recomputed on write), operator routes for `payments`, `payments/{id}/allocations`, `payments/{id}/reverse`.

Data touched: `prospectus-central/billing/payments/`, `billing/allocations/`, invoice documents (balance and status by revision compare-and-set), `billing/journal/`.

Specs: `features/billing-ledger.feature` (payment scenarios); `billing/payments.test.ts`, `billing/allocations.test.ts`; a concurrency test with two operators allocating the same payment at once.

Open question for Ryan before this is enabled: who may record and allocate external payments (epic question 4), and whether large amounts need a second operator.
